text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Lately, my shoulders and head have 
been feeling so heavy. ...Could that rumor 
actually be true?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... lately, apparently it's been 
appearing. ...A ghost on the track at 
night.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know! I-I'm not scared at all! 
There's no such thing as ghosts anyway!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the fact is, she's practicing 
out here at night... and she's in a 
slump... S-So of course I'm worried."

Perhaps from being terrified the entire 
time, Daiwa Scarlet seems to have fallen 
out of condition...
